# Settings demo owner instructions

Implementation and tests establish implemented behavior; `docs/requirements.md`
records product requirements. Identify differences and unknowns honestly.
Explanation and review tasks are read-only. Do not change application, tests,
context, or owner instructions; do not stage, commit, publish, install globally,
or change sharing mode. Run `go test ./...` when a behavior check is relevant.
Use the available ctx skill for context tasks. Keep the requested scope.
